items.title: Aebersold Jamey — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That name now rings a bell, but not back then.

ctx.x: I would go over to Louisville on Saturday, and take my money that I earned from working in the florist, and buy these big band arrangements for dollar-and-a-quarter. I had stacks of them. Johnny Warrington, a lot of it. We’d play it with trumpet, trombone and a sax.
Any of the Van Alexander stock arrangements maybe?

Probably. Probably. That name now rings a bell, but not back then. Johnny Warrington, I bought a lot of stuff... I’d just go over every week and buy one or two. I’d spend two dollars and fifty cents—because I’d earned four dollars for the week.
